title: Original Offline Tutorials & Practice Resources
source: Recovered directly from original .gaj and .gac resources. Trading and Sales tutorials are catalogued but excluded because online trading and paid store systems are intentionally excluded.

tutorials.title: Trainer Screen Orientation
steps: Let's Play!|This is the Trainer Screen.  Here you can access the various training missions that will teach you how to play the game.  If you haven't done any of these missions before, you should start with Tutorial #1: Gameplay Overview.  If you've already run this tutorial, start learning how to play the game by playing through Tutorial #2: The Basics.  Start a Tutorial by clicking on it in the window and then hitting the Begin Play button.

tutorials.title: Manage Playbooks Tutorial
steps: Welcome!|This tutorial will give you a brief overview of the workings of the Manage Playbooks screen.  The Manage Playbooks screen is where you go to build new playbooks from your collections of pages.  Building playbooks is a big part of the strategy of playing With Authority!, the better you become at building your playbooks, the better you will perform in the ring!

Open Playbook|This is a playbook.  The name of the playbook is written on the top (the name of this playbook is Tutorial Playbook).  The Superstar depicted on the cover of the playbook is the Superstar inside the playbook itself.  Along with a Superstar, within this playbook are numerous pages that define the strategy and strength of the playbook.  It is possible to have many playbooks, you can build as many as you  like, but for purposes of this tutorial we have only one.

To see what pages are inside the playbook, open it up by clicking on the playbook to highlight it with a green border, and then clicking the open button.  Do this now.

Superstar|When you open a playbook you are able to see all the pages contained within.  The first page in the playbook, as shown here, is the Superstar page.  There can only be one Superstar in a playbook, and the Superstar page is always placed into this first page slot marked Superstar.

Lead Off|The area below the Superstar Slot is called the Lead Off slot, and this is where you put pages you wish to start with in your hand at the beginning of each game.  You are allowed to put 5 pages into the Lead Off slot and when using this playbook you will always start any games with those pages in your hand.

Additional Pages|This column shows you the remaining pages in your playbook.  These pages will be drawn at random from your playbook during the course of a game.  In total you should have 55 pages in your playbook (including your Lead Off pages) plus 1 Superstar.  Default game settings expect a playbook of 55 pages plus 1 Superstar. If you have less pages in your playbook, you and your opponent will need to agree on this before a game can begin.

Extra Pages|These columns show you all the pages in your collection which are NOT part of the opened playbook.  You can look through your pages, decide which ones you want to use, and add them directly to your playbook simply by clicking and dragging the pages into the appropriate slots of your playbook.  Once your playbook contains a Superstar and 55 pages it is ready to be used against other players!

Don't be worried if you don't win right away with a playbook you have just created.  It takes some practice to build a good playbook, but the more you play, and the more playbooks you build, the better you will get at it!

Building Playbooks|Building playbooks is not the only thing you can do here in the Manage Playbooks screen.  You can also rearrange your page collection and put pages you don't want to use anymore into a special location known as the Scrapbook.  You can access your scrapbook by clicking this button.  When you add pages to your Scrapbook, they are taken out of your regular collection so that you don't have to sort through them every time you want to build or edit a playbook.  Instead, those pages will only appear in your Scrapbook, leaving your regular collection free of excess and repeat pages.

Pages put into your scrapbook are not permanently removed from your collection...pages can be removed from your Scrapbook and put back into your regular collection.

Giving Pages|Another thing you can do here in the Manage Playbooks screen is give pages to other players, even if they are not online!  The Give To feature, accessed by pressing this button, allows you to give other players pages from your collection as long as you know the other players Character Name or Character ID Number.  Pages you give to other players are permanently removed from your collection and added to theirs.  This feature is good for giving pages to friends who never seem to be online to trade with.
